assumptions: Diagnostic only: all input candidates remain research_eligible=false; unknown historical available_time is not certified.
Conditional membership uses the retained baseline and official regular-change dates; baseline and full temporary-change coverage remain unverified.
Assume same-day close and conditional membership are known at each after-close signal. Freeze target units using that close; execute only at the next session open.
Use source-native normalized/adjusted OHLC as fractional adjusted units. restored_price = raw_price / raw_factor. Do not treat raw_* as unadjusted exchange prices.
Adopt the source adjustment/reinvestment proxy without certifying its corporate-action method or revision history; do not add dividends or rights again.
No integer-share/board-lot rules, subscription cashflows, investor-specific dividend tax or corporate-action settlement delays in this adjusted-unit proxy.
Known full-day halts block trading. Missing held close is carried only on a referenced full-day halt and is explicitly logged as stale. Missing held close otherwise fails.
The selected afternoon-only halt does not block the morning opening auction. Unknown ST, price-limit and opening-volume constraints are not enforced.
Assume positive observed opening quotes can fill at the declared slippage without capacity limits. Unfilled orders expire; no automatic next-day retry.
Each security has at most one buy or sell per rebalance. No same-session round trip is requested; full real-share T+1 inventory and corporate-action rights are not modeled.
Costs are declared scenarios applied to adjusted-unit notional, not a broker-specific fee certification. Terminal holdings are marked to close, not liquidated.
No official CSI300 index benchmark is loaded. This is conditional constituent equal weight, not the published CSI300 index.
2023 is an inspected diagnostic development interval, not a blind final test. Do not read 2024-2025 price data or tune after seeing this result.
